mapper.select: SELECT privacy_log_id::TEXT AS row_id, member_id, request_uri, sql_ids, target_ids, access_cnt, device_type, user_agent, TO_CHAR(reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reg_dt, reg_ip FROM privacy_log WHERE privacy_log_id = #{rowId}::integer
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO privacy_log (member_id, request_uri, sql_ids, target_ids, access_cnt, device_type, user_agent, reg_dt, reg_ip) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{requestUri}, #{sqlIds}, #{targetIds}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{accessCnt}, '')::integer, 0), #{deviceType}, #{userAgent}, NOW(), #{regIp})
